name: Margaux - LBS MFA alumni testimonial
_note: Whole testimonial, one cut. The take is unusually clean. Three things were tried and deliberately reverted after the dry run, listed below - a polished testimonial is one with no obvious stumbles, not one cut until it sounds synthetic.

blocks.note: full testimonial: background, why London, the surprise, permission, method, PIMCO payoff

_kept_the_cut: 49.42-51.96 'people and a lot of British like' - she doubles back ('a lot of British people and a lot of British like students'). One cut takes the redundancy and the filler together, leaving 'I expected a lot of British students in general in the school'. Both edges sit in real gaps.
_reverted: 'like' in 'give yourself like the means' - the padded edge swallowed 'the', giving 'give yourself means to reach out'. Worse than the filler.
'a lot of' in 'there is a lot of right way to do it' - removing it took the article too, giving 'there is right way'. Fixing only 'lot of' needs a 100ms cut inside fast speech; not worth the click.
tighten 0.4 - only ONE pause in the take is over 0.30s, so it saved 0.24s, and the pause map and the word list disagree by ~0.3s around 21s, where it was cutting into 'I'm'.
